name: ensure-session
description: Ensure the workspace has exactly one usable terminal session

metadata.name: ensure-session
metadata.description: Ensure the workspace has exactly one usable terminal session

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const existing = document.querySelector('[data-testid="terminal-pane"]'); if (existing) return; const launch = document.querySelector('[data-testid="new-terminal-button"], [data-testid="toolbar-new"]'); if (!(launch instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error('empty workspace: new terminal control is unavailable'); launch.click(); const deadline = Date.now() + 90000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const emptyShell = document.querySelector('[data-testid="launcher-empty-shell"]'); if (emptyShell instanceof HTMLElement) { emptyShell.click(); break; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (document.querySelector('[data-testid="terminal-pane"]')) return; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } throw new Error('terminal session did not become ready within timeout'); })()

metadata.label: Create a session only when the workspace is empty
